widgets.markdown:
## Defender for Cloud posture
Secure score, recommendations, regulatory compliance and plan coverage come from Azure Resource Graph across the subscriptions you can read. Alerts, control-plane activity and exposure come from Defender XDR advanced hunting.

query.text:
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/securescores' and name == 'ascScore'
| summarize Score = round(100.0 * sum(todouble(properties.score.current)) / sum(todouble(properties.score.max)), 1)

Resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines')
| project Machine = name, Kind = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines', 'Arc', 'Azure VM'), subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, Resource = tolower(id)
// Resource Graph allows one join to SecurityResources, so the subscription's plan and every resource-level plan come in one bag.
| join kind=leftouter (SecurityResources
    | where type == 'microsoft.security/pricings' and name == 'VirtualMachines'
    | extend Path = tolower(id)
    | extend Key = iff(Path contains '/resourcegroups/', substring(Path, 0, indexof(Path, '/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/')), 'subscription')
    | summarize Plans = make_bag(pack(Key, strcat(tostring(properties.pricingTier), '|', tostring(properties.subPlan)))) by subscriptionId) on subscriptionId
| extend SubscriptionPlan = split(tostring(Plans['subscription']), '|'), OverridePlan = tostring(Plans[Resource])
| extend Tier = tostring(SubscriptionPlan[0]), SubPlan = tostring(SubscriptionPlan[1])
| extend SubscriptionCoverage = case(Tier == 'Standard' and SubPlan == 'P2', 'Plan 2', Tier == 'Standard' and SubPlan == 'P1', 'Plan 1', Tier == 'Standard', 'Standard', 'Not covered'), Overridden = isnotempty(OverridePlan)
| extend Tier = iff(Overridden, tostring(split(OverridePlan, '|')[0]), Tier), SubPlan = iff(Overridden, tostring(split(OverridePlan, '|')[1]), SubPlan)
| extend Coverage = case(Tier == 'Standard' and SubPlan == 'P2', 'Plan 2', Tier == 'Standard' and SubPlan == 'P1', 'Plan 1', Tier == 'Standard', 'Standard', 'Not covered')
| summarize Covered = countif(Coverage == 'Plan 2'), Total = count()
| project Plan2Pct = iff(Total == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Covered / Total, 1))

SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| where tostring(properties.status.code) == 'Unhealthy' and tostring(properties.metadata.severity) == 'High'
| summarize Resources = count()

SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/locations/alerts'
| where tostring(properties.Status) == 'Active' and tostring(properties.Severity) in ({AlertSeverity})
| summarize Alerts = count()

// Adapted from Microsoft Learn sample 'Secure score per subscription' (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/resource-graph-samples).
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/securescores' and name == 'ascScore'
| extend ScorePct = round(todouble(properties.score.percentage) * 100, 1), Current = todouble(properties.score.current), Max = todouble(properties.score.max)
| join kind=leftouter (ResourceContainers | where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project Subscription, subscriptionId, ScorePct, Current, Max
| order by ScorePct asc

saved.name: Defender for Cloud / Secure score per subscription

    | extend Key = iff(Path contains '/resourcegroups/', substring(Path, 0, indexof(Path, '/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/')), 'subscription')
    | summarize Plans = make_bag(pack(Key, strcat(tostring(properties.pricingTier), '|', tostring(properties.subPlan)))) by subscriptionId) on subscriptionId
| extend SubscriptionPlan = split(tostring(Plans['subscription']), '|'), OverridePlan = tostring(Plans[Resource])
| extend Tier = tostring(SubscriptionPlan[0]), SubPlan = tostring(SubscriptionPlan[1])

| extend Tier = iff(Overridden, tostring(split(OverridePlan, '|')[0]), Tier), SubPlan = iff(Overridden, tostring(split(OverridePlan, '|')[1]), SubPlan)
| extend Coverage = case(Tier == 'Standard' and SubPlan == 'P2', 'Plan 2', Tier == 'Standard' and SubPlan == 'P1', 'Plan 1', Tier == 'Standard', 'Standard', 'Not covered')
| summarize Machines = count(), OnPlan2 = countif(Coverage == 'Plan 2'), AzureVms = countif(Kind == 'Azure VM'), ArcMachines = countif(Kind == 'Arc'), ResourceOverrides = countif(Overridden) by subscriptionId, SubscriptionPlan = SubscriptionCoverage
| extend Plan2Pct = round(100.0 * OnPlan2 / Machines, 1)
| join kind=leftouter (ResourceContainers | where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project Subscription, subscriptionId, SubscriptionPlan, Plan2Pct, OnPlan2, Machines, AzureVms, ArcMachines, ResourceOverrides
| order by Plan2Pct asc, Machines desc

widgets.title: Controls with the most score to gain

query.text:
// Adapted from Microsoft Learn sample 'Controls secure score per subscription' (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/resource-graph-samples).
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/securescores/securescorecontrols'
| extend Control = tostring(properties.displayName), Current = todouble(properties.score.current), Max = todouble(properties.score.max), Unhealthy = toint(properties.unhealthyResourceCount), Healthy = toint(properties.healthyResourceCount)
| summarize Current = sum(Current), Max = sum(Max), Unhealthy = sum(Unhealthy), Healthy = sum(Healthy), Subscriptions = dcount(subscriptionId) by Control
| extend PotentialGain = round(Max - Current, 2)
| where PotentialGain > 0
| project Control, PotentialGain, Unhealthy, Healthy, Subscriptions
| order by PotentialGain desc

saved.name: Defender for Cloud / Security controls by potential score gain

query.text:
// Adapted from Microsoft Learn sample 'Regulatory compliance state per compliance standard' (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/resource-graph-samples).
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards'
| extend Passed = toint(properties.passedControls), Failed = toint(properties.failedControls), Skipped = toint(properties.skippedControls)
| summarize Passed = sum(Passed), Failed = sum(Failed), Skipped = sum(Skipped), Subscriptions = dcount(subscriptionId) by Standard = name
| extend PassedPct = round(100.0 * Passed / max_of(Passed + Failed, 1), 1)
| order by PassedPct asc

saved.name: Defender for Cloud / Regulatory compliance by standard

query.text:
// Adapted from Microsoft Learn sample 'List Microsoft Defender recommendations' (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/resource-graph-samples).
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| where tostring(properties.status.code) == 'Unhealthy'
| extend Severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| extend Recommendation = tostring(properties.displayName), Resource = tolower(substring(id, 0, indexof(id, '/providers/Microsoft.Security/assessments/'))), Source = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Source), Portal = tostring(properties.links.azurePortal)
| extend Rank = case(Severity == 'High', 1, Severity == 'Medium', 2, 3)
| project Severity, Recommendation, Resource, Source, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, Portal, Rank
| order by Rank asc, Recommendation asc
| project-away Rank

saved.name: Defender for Cloud / Unhealthy resources by recommendation

query.text:
// Adapted from Microsoft Learn sample 'Display all active Microsoft Defender for Cloud alerts' (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/resource-graph-samples).
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/locations/alerts'
| where tostring(properties.Status) == 'Active'
| extend Severity = tostring(properties.Severity)
| where Severity in ({AlertSeverity})
| project Generated = todatetime(properties.TimeGeneratedUtc), Severity, Alert = tostring(properties.AlertDisplayName), Entity = tostring(properties.CompromisedEntity), Intent = tostring(properties.Intent), subscriptionId, Portal = tostring(properties.AlertUri)
| order by Generated desc

saved.name: Defender for Cloud / Active security alerts

widgets.title: Defender for Cloud alerts over time (XDR)

query.text:
AlertInfo
| where Timestamp > ago({Lookback})
| where ServiceSource == "Microsoft Defender for Cloud"
| summarize Alerts = dcount(AlertId) by Timestamp = bin(Timestamp, 1d), Severity

CloudAuditEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({Lookback})
| where DataSource == "Azure"
| where OperationName has_any (
    "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write",
    "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/delete",
    "Microsoft.Security/pricings/write",
    "Microsoft.Security/securityContacts/delete",
    "Microsoft.Security/autoProvisioningSettings/write",
    "Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings/delete",
    "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/accessPolicies/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/write")
| project Timestamp, OperationName, ActionType, ResourceId, IPAddress, CountryCode, IsAnonymousProxy, UserAgent, RawEventData
| order by Timestamp desc

query.text:
// Adapted from the Defender for Cloud Governance workbook by Microsoft (https://github.com/microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/Workbooks/Azure%20Security%20Center/Governance/Governance.workbook), MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/assessments'
    and isnull(properties.resourceDetails.AwsResourceId)
    and isnull(properties.resourceDetails.GcpResourceId)
    and isnotempty(properties.displayName)
| project id, StatusCode = tostring(properties.status.code)
| join kind=leftouter (
    SecurityResources
    | where type == 'microsoft.security/assessments/governanceassignments'
    | project id = tostring(properties.assignedResourceId), RemediationDue = bin(todatetime(properties.remediationDueDate), 1d)
  ) on id
| extend Status = case(
    StatusCode != 'Unhealthy', 'Completed',
    isnull(RemediationDue), 'Unassigned',
    RemediationDue < bin(now(), 1d), 'Overdue',
    'On time')
| summarize Assessments = count() by Status

saved.name: Defender for Cloud / Recommendation governance status

query.text:
// Adapted from the Defender CSPM workbook by Microsoft (https://github.com/microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/Workbooks/Azure%20Security%20Center/Defender%20CSPM/DefenderCSPM.workbook), MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/attackpaths'
| summarize Paths = count() by AttackPath = tostring(properties.displayName), Risk = tostring(properties.riskLevel)
| order by Paths desc

saved.name: Defender for Cloud / Attack paths by type and risk

query.text:
// Adapted from 'Time Indicators' by Microsoft (https://github.com/Azure/Microsoft-Defender-for-Cloud/tree/main/Kusto/Azure%20Resource%20Graph/Time%20Indicators), MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
SecurityResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| where tostring(properties.status.code) =~ 'unhealthy'
| extend FirstEvaluated = todatetime(properties.status.firstEvaluationDate), UnhealthySince = todatetime(properties.status.statusChangeDate)
| extend DaysUnhealthy = datetime_diff('day', now(), UnhealthySince)
| project DaysUnhealthy, UnhealthySince, FirstEvaluated, Severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity), Recommendation = tostring(properties.displayName), Resource = tolower(substring(id, 0, indexof(id, '/providers/Microsoft.Security/assessments/'))), subscriptionId
| order by DaysUnhealthy desc

saved.name: Defender for Cloud / How long resources have been unhealthy
